chunks: Muʿāwiyah ibn Wahb narrated: I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, while we were in al-Madīnah, about preparing for ihram.

So he said: "Apply depilatory in al-Madīnah, prepare yourself with everything you need, and perform ghusl (ritual bath) if you wish. And if you wish, you may continue wearing your shirt until you come to Masjid al-Shajarah."

key_terms.بِقَمِيصِكَ: with your shirt, meaning ordinary stitched clothing
key_terms.لِلْإِحْرَامِ: for entering the state of ihram
key_terms.مَسْجِدَ الشَّجَرَةِ: Masjid al-Shajarah, the miqat location near al-Madīnah

ai.seo_question: What preparations for ihram can be done in al-Madīnah before reaching Masjid al-Shajarah?
ai.summary: This hadith explains practical preparation for entering ihram before reaching the miqat. It indicates that grooming, making preparations, and even ghusl (ritual bath) may be done in al-Madīnah, and that one may remain in ordinary clothing until arriving at Masjid al-Shajarah.
